issue.title: QuarkusSmallRyeTracingDynamicFeature bean is removed during build while needed

repository.name: quarkus-operator-sdk
repository.description: Quarkus Extension to create Kubernetes Operators in Java using the Java Operator SDK (https://github.com/java-operator-sdk/java-operator-sdk) project

issue.body:

adding `quarkus.arc.unremovable-types=io.quarkus.smallrye.opentracing.runtime.QuarkusSmallRyeTracingDynamicFeature` to application.properties as a workaround.

It seems this happens since Quarkus 2.0.0 as it does not occured in my quarkus:1.13.7/operator:1.19 apps. Someone on Quarkus repo raised a similar issue https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/18105 but got closed because the PO was actually not using a rest client.

body: I will take a look at this as @metacosm brought this to my attention via https://github.com/quarkiverse/quarkus-operator-sdk/issues/174 which seems to share the same root cause

issue.title: Move RESTEasy provider registration as unremovable beans to common module
issue.body:
This is needed because without this change, applications that only
include the rest-client without including the server component,
result in the providers not being registered as unremovable beans.

Fixes: #22605
Fixes: #20498

issue.title: QuarkusSmallRyeTracingDynamicFeature bean is removed during build
issue.body:
## Describe the bug
While using Quarkus 2.0.0.CR3 with extensions: `resteasy, rest-client, smallrye-opentracing` and no rest endpoint defined in the project, the following warning being thrown to the console:

=-=-==-=-==-=-==-=-==-=-==-=-==-=-==-=-=
CDI: programmatic lookup problem detected

At least one bean matched the required type and qualifiers but was marked as unused and removed during build
Removed beans:
        - CLASS bean io.quarkus.smallrye.opentracing.runtime.QuarkusSmallRyeTracingDynamicFeature [types=[interface javax.ws.rs.container.DynamicFeature, class io.quarkus.smallrye.opentracing.runtime.QuarkusSmallRyeTracingDynamicFeature], qualifiers=[@javax.enterprise.inject.Default(), @javax.enterprise.inject.Any()]]
Required type: class io.quarkus.smallrye.opentracing.runtime.QuarkusSmallRyeTracingDynamicFeature
Required qualifiers: [@javax.enterprise.inject.Default()]
Solutions:
        - Application developers can eliminate false positives via the @Unremovable annotation
        - Extensions can eliminate false positives via build items, e.g. using the UnremovableBeanBuildItem
        - See also https://quarkus.io/guides/cdi-reference#remove_unused_beans
=-=-==-=-==-=-==-=-==-=-==-=-==-=-==-=-=

*Without `quarkus-rest-client` extension there is no warning.

This warning is not happening with 1.13.7.Final
Probably related to https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/16101

### Expected behavior
Bean is not removed / No warning message thrown in the console?

### Actual behavior
Warning message is thrown in the console


## To Reproduce
Run `mvn clean quarkus:dev` with the attached project (no resource defined)
[getting-started1.zip](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/files/6701740/getting-started1.zip)

### Output of `java -version`
OpenJDK Runtime Environment AdoptOpenJDK-11.0.11+9 (build 11.0.11+9)

### Quarkus version or git rev
2.0.0.CR3 && 2.0.0.Final
